Quarri
Connect your accounting data

Connect QuickBooks to Quarri

Quarri copies your QuickBooks company’s accounting records into your own Quarri database each day, so you can ask questions of them alongside the rest of your business.

QuickBooks connections are not switched on yet. Ask your Quarri contact to set them up.

Quarri will:

  • Read your chart of accounts, customers, vendors and items
  • Read invoices, bills, payments, expenses and journal entries
  • Never create, change or delete anything in QuickBooks

Only the people your Quarri admin allows to see finance data can see it. A QuickBooks admin approves the connection on the next screen, once for each company, and can disconnect Quarri at any time.
